cards.issue: How sensitive this population is to the harvested process (survival)
cards.why_it_matters: About 97% (95% range 93–99%) of this plant's long-run population growth depends on survival, the process a rhizome harvest affects (6 published matrices, this species).
cards.uncertainty: No conflicts found with the audited studies. This says how sensitive the population is to the harvested process. It is not a safe harvest rate.
cards.recommended_next: Use this to judge which local measurements matter most (e.g. survival of large plants), not as a harvest limit.
